title: feat(app-shell,i18n): the console app bar's left group is the app pill and its PREVIEW chip; an object route draws no crumb; Edit app is an icon button (objectui#12461)
body:
Fixes #12461
Clause-②: no (narrowing)

Inside an app, the console top bar's left group is now the app pill and its PREVIEW chip. An object route draws no breadcrumb, and 「Edit app」 is an icon button at every width. The page header is the one place the page is named. Implemented by the `domain:ui` seat 1 dev run, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01JZnppgHRp4sREcouhkQYDB`.

## What changed

- **`AppHeader`: the object crumb is gone.** On an object route (the object's list, a view, a record), nothing follows the app pill from `sm` up. Before, the bar read the object (its 「Switch Object」 menu listing the app's other objects), then the view or the record, and on a record opened from a related list the ancestor trail (`?from=`) as links. The page header names the page, the sidebar's active entry names the object, and the saved-view strip names the view. The menu's two destinations are the sidebar (objects) and the view strip (views). What survives is `objectRouteTitle`: the page's name for the phone bar's compact title below `sm`. That title is unchanged: the record title, else the view label, else the object's plural.
  - Removed with the menu: `objectSiblings` and the app-navigation object filter that fed it, `baseHref`, and the trail's use of `decodeRecordTrail` / `buildRecordTrailHref` here (both stay in `urlParams`, and `RecordDetailView` still reads them).
  - The crumb render is plain text now: the dashboard, page, report and `system/*` crumbs it still draws never carried a link or a menu. Their classes are unchanged.
- **The PREVIEW chip** moves from the right-hand cluster (ahead of the search) to right after the app pill, ahead of any crumb, so it stays in place whatever the route draws. It keeps `hidden sm:inline-flex`. Platform surfaces are unchanged.
- **「Edit app」** is a `ghost` / `icon` button, `h-8 w-8`, like the bell beside it. It shows the pencil alone at every width, with `aria-label` and `title` from `topbar.editApp`. The `lg` text span and its `data-testid="app-design-in-studio-label"` are gone. The gate, the `appStudioRoutePath` target (the ADR-0080 bridge) and `data-testid="app-design-in-studio-button"` are unchanged.
- **`topbar.switchObject` leaves all ten packs.** Its one reader was the menu.
- **`RecordDetailView`: one comment.** It said the full clickable path lives in the top-bar breadcrumb. It now says the parent back link is the only one, and that each parent's link carries the trail above it. This file is outside the claim's file surface. No code changed; the comment would have been false after this PR.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/12461-app-bar-left-group.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` minor, `@object-ui/i18n` minor with a BREAKING note naming the key (precedent: objectui#12273).

## Published surface

Narrowing only. `@object-ui/i18n` drops `topbar.switchObject` from all ten packs with no replacement. A host that looks it up now gets the key string back. `@object-ui/app-shell` adds, removes or renames no export, prop or option. `AppHeaderProps` is byte-identical.

## Premises measured (the dispatch's A1 to A4, on base `cf430cd10`)

- **A1** holds after re-anchoring. The crumb was built from `extraSegments` (the object branch pushed the trail, the object with `siblings`, then the record or view) and rendered after the switcher. `PreviewBadge` sat in the right-hand cluster ahead of the search group. Edit app was `outline` / `sm`, with its text in a `hidden lg:inline` span.
- **A2: collateral readers.** `git grep` over the tree found no `document.title` effect, e2e selector or other module that reads `extraSegments` or the crumb output. The readers are these `AppHeader` suites: `objectCrumbPlural-11696` (the menu siblings and the record cell), `dashboardReportCrumb-12273` (the object list and record cells), `appIdentity-12201` (items 5 and 6) and `servedLabels-11295`. The 11295 suite stays green: its view cells read the phone title now, and a docblock line says so. One behaviour went with the crumb and lives in the bar itself: the one-click jump to a grandparent in a related-record trail. `RecordDetailView`'s parent back link remains, and each parent carries the trail above it, so every ancestor is still reachable one step at a time. Nothing new was built for it.
- **A3** holds. The `system/*` crumb pins (`systemBreadcrumbs-10969`, `marketplaceBreadcrumb-10900`, the `system` CONTROL in 12273) and the `home` / `orgs` / `studio` pins (`studioVariant-11863`, `myOrganizations`, `singleMembershipOrg`, the Home controls in 12201) pass unchanged. Below `sm` the phone title is unchanged, and pinned below.
- **A4** half-holds. `topbar.editApp` is unchanged. One key changed: `topbar.switchObject` was removed with its reader, in all ten packs, and the i18n gates ran (see Gates).

## Read from the card, not built: the search is not centered on `main`

The card's item 3 says "The search stays centered". On base `cf430cd10` it is not. `AppHeader`'s root is `flex justify-between`, the left group is `flex-1`, and the search trigger is the first item of the right-hand `shrink-0` cluster. So at 1440 it sits at the left edge of the utility cluster, right of center. This PR leaves it where it is: the card asked for no move, and the root layout is shared with the `home` / `orgs` / `studio` variants the card fences out. See Acceptance notes.

## Tests

New `packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/AppHeader.appBarLeftGroup-12461.test.tsx` renders the real `AppHeader`, `Button`, `PreviewBadge` and search trigger, on `/apps/crm/lead`, a view route and a record route with a `?from=` trail. Ten cells:

- the pill, the chip, the search, and a link named 「Edit app」 to `/studio/PACKAGE/`;
- the chip is the pill's next sibling, every later sibling is `sm:hidden`, and there are no separators;
- no leaf element outside `sm:hidden` reads `Leads` or `Lead`;
- no 「Switch Object」 menu and no link to an object list;
- Edit app has empty text, an `svg`, `h-8 w-8`, and no breakpoint class that would grow text;
- the view and record routes draw no crumb, and no `Leads`, `Accounts`, `Acme` or record title appears outside `sm:hidden`;
- CONTROLS: the `system/settings` crumbs still draw, after the chip; the phone title is the plural on the list and the record on a record route.

Updated cells (their docblocks name objectui#12461): 12201 items 5 and 6, 12273's object list and record cells, and 11696's siblings and record cells.

Run at `4a036ae8d4`, from the repo root, under the verify lock: every suite that names `AppHeader` or `ConsoleLayout` (72 files, from `git grep -l -E 'AppHeader|ConsoleLayout'`) plus `packages/i18n/`. Result: `Test Files 155 passed (155)`, `Tests 1919 passed | 13 skipped (1932)`.

### Ablations (one per new pin, committed head, `ablation-replace` with on-disk proof; the suite imports `../AppHeader` from source, so there is no `dist` leg)

| leg | mutation | red | restore |
|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | the object branch pushes the plural crumb again | 5 of 10: left group, no-object-label, view route, record route, phone-title CONTROL (two `Leads` now) | blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty |
| A2 | the chip moved back ahead of the search group | 2 of 10: left group, `system` CONTROL (chip no longer ahead of the crumbs) | same |
| A3 | the `hidden lg:inline` 「Edit app」 text span put back | 1 of 10: the icon-only cell | same |

Control on the restored tree: `Tests 10 passed (10)`. The first ablation run was a no-op: each replacement contained its anchor, and the tool refused because the anchor count did not drop. No suite ran on that pass. The anchors were changed and every leg re-run. The readings above are from the second run.

## Gates (local, at `4a036ae8d4`; CI runs the farm)

- `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2`: 28 of 28 tasks, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0. `tsconfig.test.json`'s `--listFilesOnly` includes the five touched suites.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check`: exit 0.
- `apps/console` `vite build`, exit 0, then `pnpm check:eager-closure`: exit 0.
- Exit 0 each: `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys` (report-only; no `switchObject` line), `check:eager-locale-catalogues`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the changed files: 0 errors. `AppHeader.tsx` has 17 warnings (base: 22).
- Not run locally: `pnpm lint` over the repo and the full `pnpm test`. Both are CI's.

## Browser reading

Not taken. The console needs a backend on this container, and the sibling objectstack checkout has no install, so booting one was not practical in this run. The landing seat takes the 1440 reading on the HotCRM Leads list.

## Acceptance notes

- **The search is not centered** (above). This is a design gap against the card's target, not built here. A follow-up would center the search in app context only, or across all variants. That is a layout change to the shared root, and the card's fence on the variants is the reason it is not in this PR.
- **Dashboard, page and report routes still draw their crumb** after the chip. The card's build list names the object crumb. Those three routes carry crumbs shaped by the maintainer's ruling on cloud#2768 (objectui#12198, objectui#12273), and the dashboard and report views draw their own header. Whether "nothing names the page but the page header" reaches them is the maintainer's call. That includes a `page` route, whose view draws no header of its own.
- **`system/*` routes keep their crumbs**, per the card's fence.
- Same file as objectui#12429 (sidebar trigger). This PR does not touch `LocalizedSidebarTrigger` or the mobile search button. `main` was still `cf430cd10` at the pre-PR fetch, so no merge was needed.
